feedback: The dashboard takes forever to load when I have more than 10 widgets. It becomes almost unusable.
Loading the main dashboard is painfully slow. I wait 10+ seconds every morning just to see my data.
Dashboard refresh is extremely slow. Our team has complained multiple times about this issue.
Every time I open the dashboard with all my charts enabled it freezes for a while. Please fix the speed.
I wish the dashboard would load faster. The lag is really frustrating during our daily standups.
Please add a dark mode option. Staring at a white screen all day is tiring for my eyes.
No dark mode support in 2024 is unacceptable. This is a basic feature that almost every app has now.
Would love a dark theme for the interface. I work late hours and the bright UI is very harsh.
Several users on our team have requested a dark mode or at least a way to reduce screen brightness.
The UI looks outdated. A modern dark mode would make the product feel much more professional.
I get way too many notifications and cannot figure out how to turn specific ones off.
Notification settings are confusing. I ended up disabling all alerts just to stop the spam.
User is receiving duplicate email notifications for the same event. This is a known frustration.
Please give us better control over notifications. I want daily digests instead of instant alerts.
I keep missing important alerts because they get buried under too many low-priority notifications.
The reporting module is great but I cannot export reports to PDF. This is a must-have for us.
Scheduled reports would save our team hours every week. We need this feature badly.
Client needs to export the monthly report as a PDF but the option is not available.
We would love the ability to schedule automated reports to be emailed every Monday morning.
Custom date ranges in reports would be very helpful. Right now I am stuck with preset options only.
The mobile app crashes every time I try to open a large report on my phone.
The iOS app is very buggy. It crashes frequently and the layout breaks on my iPhone 14.
Mobile app keeps crashing on Android devices running version 12 and above.
The mobile experience needs serious improvement. The app feels like an afterthought compared to the web version.
I cannot access half the features on mobile. The mobile app is missing too many things.
The search bar does not find items even when I type the exact name. It is very unreliable.
Search is basically broken. I have to scroll through everything manually because search returns wrong results.
User reports that searching for project names with special characters returns no results at all.
Please improve the search functionality. It misses obvious results and the filters do not work well.
Search does not support fuzzy matching. A small typo means I get zero results.
Updating my profile information is confusing. I could not find where to change my display name.
The account settings page is poorly organized. It took me 15 minutes to find the password change option.
User cannot update their profile picture. The upload button appears but nothing happens after selecting the file.
I need the ability to manage multiple team roles from one account. The current setup is too limited.
Two-factor authentication setup was difficult to find and the instructions were unclear.
Would be great if I could pin my most-used widgets to the top of the dashboard for quick access.
Notifications should be smarter and learn what I care about over time instead of sending everything.
It would be very helpful if the mobile app had offline mode so I can check data without internet.
